ops.title: Index cleanup scheduler candidates and ship the bounded queue hot path
ops.description:
Paused cleanup repeatedly scanned every retained job before deciding no logical work was due. Maintain ordered subsets for potentially runnable logical jobs, paused registration retirement, and timer-bearing jobs as records load or change. Scheduler selection visits those subsets while retaining sequence priority, equal-sequence ordering, retry deadlines, hold rules, and existing retirement and ownership checks. Physical deletion remains paused.

CI compares the released 0.87.36 scheduler with the new implementation on the same fixture at 32, 4,096, and 65,536 records. Reference-model tests cover randomized state transitions, pause/hold/retry combinations, tied sequences, cold loading, pruning, and a fixed four-job eligible subset. No local build, test, or benchmark was run under host pressure.

ops.text: Reference-model and actual released-versus-new scheduler scaling pass on Linux and macOS
Exact reviewed head merges and official release artifacts publish
Official local update verified while protected sessions survive and physical cleanup remains paused
